summary.value: Display a group of tabs that can be toggled between.

example.value:
<Tabs onChange={(value) => console.log(value)}>
  <Tabs.List>
    <Tabs.Tab value='1'>Tab 1</Tabs.Tab>
    <Tabs.Tab value='2'>Tab 2</Tabs.Tab>
    <Tabs.Tab value='3'>Tab 3</Tabs.Tab>
  </Tabs.List>
  <Tabs.Panel value='1'>content 1</Tabs.Panel>
  <Tabs.Panel value='2'>content 2</Tabs.Panel>
  <Tabs.Panel value='3'>content 3</Tabs.Panel>
</Tabs>

a11y.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, NOT yet human-reviewed

value.rule: Icons used in tabs must be intuitive and have descriptive titles for screen readers.
value.quote: Ensure that the icons are intuitive and have descriptive titles for screen readers.

value.rule: When icons are combined with text, the icons should be decorative and marked with aria-hidden.
value.quote: Icons should be decorative and marked with aria-hidden .

value.rule: Use the ds-tabs component rather than building a custom tabs implementation, to ensure good accessibility and functionality.
value.quote: We recommend using <ds-tabs> , and not building your own tabs from scratch, to ensure good accessibility and functionality.

value.rule: Each tab must have a unique title.
value.quote: Each tab must have a unique title

value.rule: Icons used in tabs must be decorative (aria-hidden) or have descriptive titles.
value.quote: When using icons, ensure they are decorative ( aria-hidden ) or have descriptive titles

value.rule: If a tab panel has no focusable elements, the panel itself receives focus.
value.quote: If a tab panel does not contain any focusable elements, the panel itself receives focus

value.rule: Tabs support keyboard navigation with arrow keys.
value.quote: Tabs supports keyboard navigation with arrow keys

composition.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, NOT yet human-reviewed

value.rule: Use tabs when content needs structuring without loading a new page, when information benefits from being divided into clearly labelled sections, and when navigation becomes easier without viewing all content at once.
value.quote: Use tabs when content needs to be structured without loading a new page information benefits from being divided into clearly labelled sections navigation becomes easier when users do not need to view all content at once

value.rule: Avoid tabs when an immediate overview is needed, when information must be compared across sections, for step-by-step processes where order matters, for large amounts of content, or when the content could be shown on a single page or spread across several pages.
value.quote: Avoid using tabs when it is important to give an immediate overview of the content information needs to be compared across sections users must go through a step-by-step process where the order matters large amounts of content may slow down the page the content could just as well be shown on a single page or spread across several pages

value.rule: Before choosing tabs, consider simplifying content, distributing it across pages, keeping it on a single page with clear headings, or using a table of contents.
value.quote: Before choosing tabs, consider whether it might be better to: simplify and reduce the amount of content distribute the content across several pages keep everything on a single page with clear headings use a table of contents for easier navigation

value.rule: Limit the number of tabs, since too many make it hard to get an overview, especially on small screens.
value.quote: Limit the number of tabs - too many make it difficult to get an overview, especially on small screens

value.rule: Use clear, descriptive tab names since tabs hide content and it must be obvious what each section contains.
value.quote: Use clear, descriptive names - tabs hide content, so it must be obvious what each section contains

value.rule: Place the most important content first, organising tabs according to users' needs.
value.quote: Place the most important content first - organise tabs according to users' needs

value.rule: Keep tabs on a single line, since long labels or too many tabs make navigation harder.
value.quote: Keep tabs on a single line - long labels or too many tabs make navigation harder

value.rule: Avoid disabled tabs; remove them or explain why they contain no content.
value.quote: Avoid disabled tabs - remove them or explain why they contain no content

value.rule: Tab labels should be short and descriptive so users understand what they will find when clicking.
value.quote: Tabs labels should be short and descriptive so users can easily understand what they will find when clicking.

value.rule: Difficulty creating clear tab labels may indicate the content is not well structured.
value.quote: If it is difficult to create clear labels, it may indicate that the content is not well structured.

value.rule: If additional context is needed, a shared heading can be placed above the tabs component.
value.quote: If additional context is needed, a shared heading can be placed above the tabs component.
